base_footprint_to_base_link_z_conflict_m.resolution: Selected target remains Hive2 motion RSP z=0.90 m. Latest 2026-10-26 installed SLAM release reportedly starts mount_tf_publisher_node with launch_robot_state_publisher default true, URDF footprint_xyz=0 0 0.3. Explicitly disable SLAM RSP and verify live unique authority before clearing P0.
base_footprint_to_base_link_z_conflict_m.slam_stack_note: 0.30m is obsolete as DESIRED value but remains configured and enabled BY DEFAULT in latest SLAM release. Runtime launch flags and published TF still unverified.
base_footprint_to_base_link_z_conflict_m.optional_runtime_disable_interface: robot_state_publisher/set_enable_publish {data:false}; verify exact availability and effect in installed release before use

leg_and_height.reported_lidar_sphere_measured_height_no: 独立现场测量记录，不等同于实时 base_link/雷达坐标变换

latest_slam_mount_rsp.source: 2026-10-26 SLAM installed release audit; preprocessing.launch.py / console_slam3d_bringup.py

default_filtered_cloud.pipeline: livox_frame raw -> base_link geometric filtering -> lidar_link geo_filtered output; NOT map frame

expected_tf_edges.availability: Only Mapping Live or Localization Tracking; tracking status + registration_output_tf_published true required; map TF existence alone insufficient.

expected_tf_edges.source: Hive2 motion RSP (user-selected authority candidate, 0.90 m configuration)
expected_tf_edges.availability: Current selected 0.90m from motion RSP; latest SLAM default still publishes 0.30m unless explicitly disabled. Runtime publisher uniqueness unverified.

observed_failure_modes: 未定位/离线时 map frame 不存在
相同 TF 边被两个 RSP 以不同高度发布
2026-10-26 SLAM release: launch_robot_state_publisher default true and mount TF z=0.30, despite user selecting motion stack z=0.90
SLAM mount_tf_publisher_node ROS node name robot_state_publisher might duplicate motion RSP node name
geo_filtered geometric filtering in base_link does not imply output is in map; output frame stays lidar_link
slam_interface.bag_note: 只证明该会话观察到相关边；不能推断当前实时 TF 有效

localization_readiness.message_definition: LocalizationStatus.msg from latest SLAM release; exact ROS package and outer/inner field names still require schema inspection before writing subscriber
localization_readiness.state_name_case_and_serialization: inspect actual .msg before implementation; do not assume an unverified field layout
localization_readiness.note: Boolean true/TF presence alone is insufficient; require both tracking state and contemporaneous transform.

tf_edge_ownership_proposed.map_to_base_footprint: slam3d_node only; based on Mapping Live or Localization Tracking
tf_edge_ownership_proposed.duplicate_rsp_risk: SLAM mount_tf_publisher_node named robot_state_publisher may collide with motion-stack RSP ROS node name

navigation_requirements.source: N-01导航算法需求规格说明书_优化版_20261017.docx（用户审计报告）
navigation_requirements.chassis_omega_per_linear_note: 底盘比例参数，不是药厂已批准的最大角速度
navigation_requirements.preliminary_safety_radius_status: 乙方设计文档暂定，待甲方确认，不是正式安全标准

g1_offline_synthetic_reference.scope: G1 isolated synthetic pointcloud and stationary odometry only; NOT Hive2 hardware geometry
g1_offline_synthetic_reference.prohibition: 不得当作 Hive2 真机尺寸、雷达高度、真机最大速度或正式药厂安全参数

blocking_open_items.detail: Latest SLAM release (2026-10-26) still enables mount_tf_publisher_node by default (0.30m). Require explicit SLAM RSP disabled + motion RSP 0.90m + evidence of unique base_footprint->base_link TF publication, including same-name RSP collision risk.

Use /localization_status with registration_output_tf_published=true AND outer=Localization inner=tracking; fresh status & map->base_footprint TF at scan timestamp. Inspect actual message definition for member names.
geo_filtered PointCloud2 is lidar_link despite base_link filtering. Require sensor timestamp map<-lidar_link lookup; fail closed if missing; G1 world synthetic test does not cover this.
含轮、腿、外壳及不同步态的整机安全碰撞包络
真实运行姿态下最小离地间隙与机身动态高度
甲方批准的安全距离、最大角速度、制动距离及不同动态对象约束

operational_guardrails: 档案只供后续参数审计和适配决策，不能被 launch 当做实际 ROS 配置加载
不自动修改运动栈/SLAM TF、SCAN planner.yaml、传感器话题、底盘限速
记录中 hardware external_reported 不代表已完成现场测量/真机校准
G1 离线合成环境与真机参数必须分别管理
任何实机集成前需解决 P0 项并通过离线参数/TF 校验；严禁用离线冒烟结果声称可直接实机运行
最新 SLAM release 0.30m 的默认发布风险尚在，不能只凭已选定0.90m判断双 RSP 冲突已解除
预检仅只读采集，不启动真机、不更改甲方SLAM发布开关；运行方需显式管理该开关
定位就绪须同时包含最新LocalizationStatus跟踪和registration_output_tf_published标志，缺失任何一项默认阻止导航
G1合成world坐标不能证明lidar_link到map的坐标转换已完成

decision_log.source_of_decision: user explicitly selected 0.90 m as the latest adapted value
decision_log.note: Historical 0.30 m is retained only for provenance, not used as current Hive2 reference; confirm no duplicate publisher at runtime.

decision_log.item: 2026-10-26 latest SLAM release audit corrects default RSP status
decision_log.prior_incorrect_assumption: 0.30m SLAM RSP is merely historical and disabled
decision_log.corrected_finding: Launch flag launch_robot_state_publisher defaults true in latest SLAM release, mount TF z=0.30m; thus simultaneous default SLAM + motion may publish conflicting transform.
decision_log.implementation_requirement: SLAM explicitly disables its mount RSP, motion RSP is sole base chain publisher, preflight checks runtime.

not_sufficient: manually relabel pointcloud frame_id to map
p0_preflight_plan.rationale: One /tf_static topic publisher may broadcast many edges; edge-specific ownership requires config/graph review and observed TF messages.
